lines.text: The Israelites broke the sacred pillars and tore down the high places throughout Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim and Manasseh.
Hezekiah gave from his own possessions for the regular offerings and commanded the people in Jerusalem to contribute for the priests and Levites.
The people brought a tithe of everything in large heaps, beginning in the third month and finishing in the twelfth month.
Azariah, the chief priest, told Hezekiah the LORD had blessed His people, and Hezekiah commanded them to prepare altars in the house of the LORD.
Hezekiah did what was good and upright and true before the LORD his God, and he prospered.
